earlierFailures.observation: The first file click did not display public/index.html before a 20-second wait expired.
earlierFailures.classification: Unreproduced test instability; not claimed fixed.
earlierFailures.followUp: Full instrumented run and unchanged ordinary verifier both passed. No product code or selector was changed.

earlierFailures.observation: The send helper returned on the pre-existing idle status before the disclosure dialog opened. The dialog was still open at timeout.
earlierFailures.followUp: Wait for an open disclosure dialog, running state or error; do not return on pre-existing idle.

earlierFailures.observation: The verifier waited for the old file approval label.
earlierFailures.followUp: Use the current explicit once-approval button; still assert no file change before approval.

earlierFailures.observation: The verifier expected an old result heading and checklist removed by the approved compact UI.
earlierFailures.followUp: Verify actual command output and exit code in Activity, the compact receipt, preview content and real console error. Open More choices before feedback/task approval and undo.

earlierFailures.observation: The verifier expected another disclosure dialog for the already approved AI.
earlierFailures.followUp: Allow the existing shared one-time consent and verify the actual outgoing follow-up request.

earlierFailures.observation: The verifier expected a historical heading for copied conversation context.
earlierFailures.followUp: Inspect the actual new model request.

earlierFailures.observation: The verifier expected a handoff text block, although the resumed engine sends original user/assistant messages.
earlierFailures.followUp: Assert the original user message and completed build answer appear with their roles in the concrete new follow-up request, and that planning leaves the project file unchanged.

checksPreserved: No file write before explicit approval

review.commentOnlyDifference: The final approvals script differs from its executed passing hash only in the explanatory opening comment.

limitations: One initial workspace file-click timeout could not be reproduced.
This suite uses controlled local model replies; it is not evidence of live-model design quality or an end-to-end packaged DMG run.
Raw logs, local paths and test-profile contents are deliberately excluded from this public summary.
